about_short_description.short_description: Convex provides a backend platform with a reactive database, serverless functions, and real-time data synchronization for web apps

product.name: Convex Reactive Database
product.description: A serverless, reactive database platform that manages global state for web applications with real-time synchronization and TypeScript-based backend code.

product.name: Convex Components
product.description: Modular, independent TypeScript building blocks for backend features, including real-time presence, durable functions, and third-party integrations.

product.name: AI Coding with Convex
product.description: AI-assisted generation of high-quality Convex backend code in TypeScript to accelerate development workflows.

product.name: Authentication Integrations
product.description: Support for over 80 OAuth providers to handle user authentication within Convex applications.

product.name: Open Source and Self-Hosting
product.description: The Convex backend is open source, allowing developers to self-host and develop locally for compliance and faster iteration.

product.name: Convex for Startups Program
product.description: A program offering startups up to one year free access to Convex Professional plan with usage discounts.
